description: List the recent runs of the reward distributor for locked units (id, date, type, total_distributed, total_stakers, status). A reward on locked units is a separate switch per registry (`staking_rewards_enabled`): discretionary, paid in platform units, off on the public network, where the distributor pays nothing. Public, no auth.
name: theprotocol_getStakingDistributions
title: Get Staking Distributions
